title: DIVINE PROTECTION
STRONG TOWER REFUGE
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: sunlit mountain pass dawn golden rays
peaceful river winding through green hills
dramatic clouds with golden light breaking through
serene pine forest in soft morning light
calm alpine lake reflecting high peaks

scenes.a: If that lonely road ahead makes your footsteps falter, stay and take refuge here.
Father, we place every step and every unseen concern under your divine protection today.
When the path grows steep and hidden dangers surround us, your word remains our strong tower.
Your holy promise declares that For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
Lord, surround our coming and our going with your heavenly guards and quiet our anxious hearts.
Grant us steadfast peace as we walk in your safe-keeping now and forevermore. Amen.
